summary_1line: The creature recounts the De Lacey family’s downfall after Felix rescues Safie’s father, whose betrayal leads to their exile until Safie courageously journeys to reunite with Felix.

image_candidates.scene_text: At night Felix whispers through the grated prison window to the chained Turkish merchant in a dark dungeon.
Safie secretly leaves Italy with jewels and money, setting out on a solitary journey toward Germany.
The blind De Lacey and Agatha sit in a dim prison cell after being arrested for Felix’s rescue plot.
